Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory46.jpg'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Inside the sealed briefing room, cold emergency lights wash across the polished alloy surface of the long table, casting every face in the room in rigid, solemn light.'}
{3: 'The hum of mechanical cooling and the faint tang of gun metal hang in the air. A critical briefing on the future of the Atlantic warzone is drawing to a close.'}
{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: "That concludes my briefing on Babylonia's operations for the Atlantic theater to date.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The words have barely settled when Officer A leans forward slightly from his seat across the table with a look of quiet certainty in his eyes.'}
{2: 'Officer A', 3: 'The only major threat left on our hands is the dam called "Atlantic Eye", is that so?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: "That is certainly a crisis, but it's not what we're here to discuss.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Officer A', 3: 'Oh? Then what is?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'Arius, the Ascendant and the true power behind the Transatlantic Economic Community, and the organization backing him.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: "That's precisely why we pulled personnel from the main assault at the dam to hold this separate briefing.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The man chairing the meeting switches the projection and brings up an image of a figure clad in a hooded cloak and a half mask.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Officer A', 3: '有推论说，大西洋这里的事件是与先前那系列危机的延伸。', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Construct A', 3: "I've already seen the reports from the Balder on the Ascendant Arius.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Construct B', 3: "Hold on, what's this about an organization behind him? Don't tell me Arius is connected to Luna's group... or Vonnegut's group?", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Officer B', 3: "That can't be right... Haven't the reports mentioned the Ascendant Arius only?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'A dozen voices erupt at once, filling every corner of the sealed room with confusion, speculation, and doubt. Every eye is fixed on the projected image of Arius.'}
{3: 'Amid the clamor, three figures remain silent, conspicuously out of place.'}

{1: '1', 3: "Two of them, a man and a woman, sit side by side, both radiating a cold, guarded tension. The man wears a permanent scowl, while the woman's face is hidden behind a visor, her thoughts impossible to read."}
{1: '1', 3: 'The third is Leia. Fidgety and visibly out of her element, she shifts in her seat with a restless, unfocused gaze.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Operations Officer', 3: "I'll address your questions one at a time. Yes, Arius was the only active Ascendant during the Balder operation.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'However, Leia here, a Construct from Egret, had confirmed the involvement of another Ascendant back in Port Podesta.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: 'Right... when we were assisting Gray Raven with the incident, we confirmed the involvement of the Ascendant Lithos from the files.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The moment her name is called, Leia snaps upright, blurting out a response on autopilot.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Construct B', 3: "Lithos... that's an Ascendant from Vonnegut's group, isn't it? So is this incident their doing again?", 4: '1'}
{3: "Leia's mouth hangs open. Unable to answer the question, she freezes in place awkwardly."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'No. Having examined previous incidents, command believes Arius belongs to an unconfirmed, previously unknown Ascendant faction.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: "The faction's central figure is believed to be Aisling, the child-like Ascendant encountered by Gray Raven when they deployed the Limpidity frame.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The Operations Officer taps the projection, and the screen shifts to the blurred silhouette of a slight and young child. Her long blue hair is the only detail that stands out.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Officer A', 3: 'A new Ascendant faction... Do we have any estimate of their numbers?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: '???', 3: "The scale and details are still being confirmed, sir, but time's up. The Purifying Force has missions to get to.", 4: '1'}
{3: "The moment the wall clock ticks over to zero, Issarius, silent until now, rises from his seat and cuts off the room's questions."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Operations Officer', 3: "I didn't notice the time. Let's cut to the conclusion.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: "As Issarius said, intel on this unknown faction is what we need to pin down. That's why we've pulled together specialists like yourselves, people who know how to work independently and gather intel.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: "Here are your assignments: units with combat designations 104 through 120, I'm ordering you to pull every combat report from the Atlantic theater to date and verify the contents.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'Leave no stone unturned. I want every scrap of intel on the Ascendants.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: "As for the two from the Purifying Force, you'll be running a force recon mission alongside this Egret member, tracking down any Ascendant activity hiding in the area.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'What? Force recon...? Me?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'Correct, your commandant has already been briefed, and you can check with Issarius for the details. Our next meeting is tomorrow at 10:00. Dismissed.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The room responds in unison. Only Leia trails a beat behind, her reply barely above a murmur.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The meeting breaks, and the room empties out. Before Leia can even collect herself, two sharp presences close in on both sides, sweeping her along.'}
{3: 'Leia shakes herself back to reality and hurries to match their pace.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1316.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Issarius', 3: "Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Issarius. I'm from the Purifying Force.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: "Me too. I'm Sylph.", 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory420.png'}

{3: 'Neither of them so much as slows down through the exchange as they go straight through the bustling lobby of the base and into the quiet corridor beyond. Leia scrambles desperately for something else to say.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "Oh, right, so I'll be joining you two on the recon mission, yeah?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: "Yes. Given the mission's difficulty, we were hand-picked for our combat capabilities... though I thought all of Egret would be here.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: "Leia... mind if I call you that? Why are you here alone? Didn't your commandant and the rest of your squad come with you?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "Ah, well, it's because—", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1591.jpg'}
{3: 'When the Port Podesta incident comes to a close, Leia does not follow Gray Raven back. Instead, she hitches a ride on a logistics convoy and drifts slowly toward the Atlantic Eye.'}

{3: 'Her mind refuses to settle the whole voyage, replaying the chance encounter with Arius repeatedly. Every time the Ascendant crosses her thoughts, an oppressive and familiar feeling wells up from somewhere deep.'}
{3: "While she is lost in thought, the squad's private comms channel flares to life. The sharp alert tone cuts through the silence."}
{3: "She picks up, and is immediately met with Vanessa's scowling face and a torrent of scolding."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vanessa', 3: 'Leia, I genuinely did not realize how incapable you are of sitting still.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vanessa', 3: 'Go on then, explain to me exactly what possessed you to wander all the way out to the Atlantic on your own without any orders from your commandant.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'W-well... I had a sudden flash of inspiration.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vanessa', 3: '有了灵感就能跑到大西洋那种地方吗，明明平时脑袋空空像个笨蛋似的，看来下次出门前我得先把你绑起来，免得你又到处乱跑。', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Bambinata', 3: 'Apologies, Mistress. If Bambinata had stopped her...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vanessa', 3: "You couldn't have stopped her anyway... And where's Mio? I don't see her on the call.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mio Kurono', 3: "I-I'm here... I just had stealth mode on.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Vanessa', 3: 'Why would you have stealth mode on during a squad call... How did Egret end up saddled with losers like you? What on earth was I thinking when I brought you two on as reserves?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She does not say it out loud, but the way Vanessa pinches the bridge of her nose and frowns on the call says it all. Just thinking about it makes her want to slap her past self.'}
{2: 'Vanessa', 3: 'Enough. Back to business... Command just issued orders for Egret to reinforce the Atlantic front and join the upcoming battle.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Ha, so I stumbled into the right place after all?', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{3: "A cold smile creeps across Vanessa's lips."}
{2: 'Vanessa', 3: "So, Leia... you're going to make yourself useful with grunt work until we arrive.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vanessa', 3: "Sit in on meetings, take notes, run missions... I'll send you wherever someone needs a hand. Lucky for me, the Atlantic is short-staffed everywhere.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Vanessa', 3: "I'm not expecting any miracles from you, but you'd better give me a full report on everything you did and every piece of intel you picked up along the way after we reconvene.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vanessa', 3: "And if I find out you miss something because you couldn't be bothered—", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vanessa', 3: "I trust I don't need to spell it out for you.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory420.png'}
{3: "Leia's transfer orders arrive almost immediately after the call has ended. Left with no choice, she boards the next ship bound for the rear of the Atlantic theater."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'I was barely off the ship before I got dragged straight into a briefing...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: 'I see. So you arrived ahead of the rest of the Egret squad?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "Yeah, though I didn't expect to be assigned a mission alongside you. Even back on Babylonia, I barely ever crossed paths with the Purifying Force.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'At first, Leia does not think much of it, but a few turns later, she notices that everyone is going out of their way to avoid the two Purifying Force members.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: 'Does it bother you...? The nature of our role tends to draw that kind of attention.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "Not at all. I'm just curious about our mission.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Leia waves her hands quickly, dismissing Sylph's concern."}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "I mean, the briefing said our priority is investigating the Ascendants, right? I'm just wondering what that has to do with the Purifying Force.", 4: '1'}

{3: 'The Purifying Force was one of the first things Leia heard about when she came to Babylonia. A revered and feared unit, they exist as the last blade of military discipline to address traitors and threats from within.'}
{3: 'And their presence here can only mean... The thought trails off, and something clicks into place for Leia.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1312.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}

{3: "Issarius' voice interrupts her thoughts, and she realizes they have made it to the deepest part of the base. Security cameras track them from all angles, and a door locked behind security clearance stands before them."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1312.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'What is this place?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Issarius', 3: 'Solitary confinement for someone we caught last night.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'As he answers, Issarius gestures for Sylph to open the door.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront170.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront171.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront43.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1423.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront170.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront171.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'RImgBg3Shake'}
{3: 'A sharp chime rings out, and the heavy alloy door slides open on both sides. Harsh white light spills out from within, illuminating the small, cold cell.'}
{3: 'Sylph steps to the side of the door and finally gives Leia the answer she has been waiting for.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: 'You were wondering why the Purifying Force is involved, right?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: "Officially, we're either here on a supervisory mission, or we've been reassigned to cover a manpower shortage.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: "But the real reason we're here is exactly what you're thinking.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Following the light, Leia looks into the cell and sees a middle-aged man slumped in a chair. His wrists and ankles are in shackles, his face gaunt and his eyes vacant.'}
{3: 'His tattered clothes and untreated cuts, still caked with grime, speak to whatever danger he faced before he ended up here.'}
{3: 'The man sits with his eyes downcast silently. Despair hangs over him like a shroud.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: "That's right. He's the key to our recon mission.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: "The prisoner's name is Jorge, a Support Force sector commander in the Atlantic theater, and a decorated veteran who has served since the Great Evacuation.", 4: '1'}
{3: "At that, Sylph's tone turns cold."}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: 'But at the same time, he carries another title... one who bent the knee to the Ascendant, and in doing so, betrayed Babylonia.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: 'A traitor.', 4: '1'}
